cleanup: 33 degenerate gaussians removed (0.013%): 32 strays outside 1.6x the 1-99 percentile box and 1 oversized blob. Already centred.
caveats: Third attempt, and the first that is actually the Fernsehturm. The sphere carries its observation-deck ring and the antenna its red and white banding, where the earlier tries gave a smooth cone with a bead on top.

What fixed it was the camera position of the input, not any parameter: a photograph taken from a distance at roughly tower height shows the sphere as a sphere, while one taken from the foot looks up the shaft and foreshortens the sphere into nothing.
